title: Nell's Wobbly Swing
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.brief: Nell the bee looking up at a thick branch of a big oak tree, an idea in mind.
Nell the bee tying a long, thin plant stem around a branch of the oak.
Nell the bee perched on the dangling end of the plant stem, ready to swing.
The thin stem snapping apart, Nell the bee tumbling toward the ground.
Nell the bee landing with a soft bump in a patch of grass below the oak.
Nell the bee sitting up in the grass, dusting herself off, looking slightly annoyed.
Nell the bee selecting a much thicker, sturdier twig from the ground.
Nell the bee securely tying the thick twig to the same branch of the oak.
The thick twig swing hanging steady and strong from the oak branch.
Nell the bee swinging happily back and forth on the sturdy twig swing.
